name: AI Tech Packs
long_description: AI Tech Packs is software that generates factory-ready techpacks in minutes for apparel design teams who currently spend 3-4 hours on each one. Our customers are brands, licensing companies, and manufacturers producing 200+ techpacks a month. We make their designers 3x more productive without new hires.
one_liner: Build factory ready tech packs in minutes.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
I started coding because my parents didn't let me play video games and I had to learn how to build them myself. 

I grew up being inspired by a lot of web based games that were popular on websites such as addictinggames.com and aromorgames.com.




This is an era that has now passed. 

Now, I am working on Muse so we can reimagine websites as games to make the internet fun once again.
